basis: Microcephaly and immunodeficiency define NBS; supplied HPO reports cytopenias and anal malformations at 80-99%, although these frequencies are clinically atypical.
Congenital absence of both upper limbs is a structural musculoskeletal disorder.
CNS melanocytic proliferation and congenital melanocytic nevi define the disease; visual impairment and optic atrophy occur in fewer than 30%.
Substance-withdrawal disorder without inherent lasting organ damage; withdrawal delirium is a distinct subtype and alcohol-related organ diseases are separate.
Juvenile open-angle glaucoma causes optic nerve injury and visual field loss.
Heart failure defines cardiac dysfunction; breathlessness alone does not establish pulmonary disease.
Degeneration is located in the retina; retinal disease belongs to the ocular axis.
Epilepsy and speech dyspraxia define a neurological and neurodevelopmental disorder.
Lethal brittle-bone disorder within the osteogenesis imperfecta spectrum; additional intrinsic organ involvement is not established.
Ptosis, impaired eye movement and absent lacrimal puncta define it; tricuspid regurgitation occurs in 30-79%; minor skeletal and ear dysmorphism does not establish functional damage.
Inherited surfactant metabolism or clearance defects cause alveolar accumulation and lung dysfunction; this hereditary form is not inherently autoimmune.
Calsequestrin-containing aggregates directly affect skeletal muscle; neurological ancestry does not establish nerve involvement.
Lymphoid hematologic malignancy arising in the colon; lymphoma also requires the infectious_immune mechanism axis.
UV-associated dermatitis directly affects skin; phototoxic injury is not inherently immune-mediated, and photoallergy is not universal.
Benign squamous epithelial tumour arising in the urinary bladder, which belongs to the renal axis.
Nonsyndromic profound prelingual sensorineural hearing loss directly affects hearing.
Joint fusion and structural hand and foot anomalies define it; hearing impairment occurs in 5-29%; dermatoglyphic differences do not establish skin damage.
Congenital megacystis affects the bladder in 13/14; cardiac defects occur individually in 1-2/14, with overlap unknown, so overall cardiac involvement above 30% is unproven.
Inherited skin blistering spreading from extremities toward the trunk defines this subtype; common extracutaneous injury is not established.
Marfanoid habitus and joint hypermobility support musculoskeletal involvement; the record does not establish aortic, ocular or damaging skin manifestations.
Arterial anomalies directly concern blood vessels; the supplied phenotype confirms cardiovascular involvement.
Clonal monoclonal gammopathy is hematologic; attributable end-organ damage is absent by definition, and progression to malignancy is a later risk.
Persistent severe neutrophil depletion is a blood-cell disorder causing innate immunodeficiency; infection sites are variable and separately diagnosed.
Cobalamin metabolic disorder; encephalopathy, profound developmental impairment and seizures occur in 1/1 reported patient; hyperopia and strabismus do not establish ocular degeneration.
Retinal dystrophy, obesity and renal disease are defining BBS features; developmental delay and intellectual disability occur in 1/1 reported BBS14 patient.
